Game Overview

PizzaFall is a arcade title where navigate a dynamic world as a battle-ready pizza slice in PizzaFall. Engage in fast-paced action against quirky foes, shooting from boot-based weaponry. Explore diverse landscapes, from mountains to sewers, while upgrading abilities for survival. Expect a charming twist on arcade action with innovative gameplay and endless fun.
